title: Make Those Captions TikTok Bold
tests: Tests revising previously created subtitles into large bold TikTok-safe captions while preserving speech, timing, and subject visibility.

got.question: How long is the clip, and is she speaking English or another language? I’ll keep her original voice unchanged.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: to make your mornings less stressful!

faults.what: The final video remains landscape instead of the requested vertical 9:16 format.
The opening and closing captions use different punctuation from the required exact text.

judge.summary: The output adds large, readable captions and keeps her face clear, but fails to convert the video to vertical.

must_haves.item: The final video is vertical 9:16 and retains the full 10-second source sequence.
must_haves.why: The final clip is reported as 10 seconds, but every supplied frame remains landscape rather than 9:16.

must_haves.item: The English captions are visibly larger and bolder than in the first version, with strong contrast against the footage.
must_haves.why: The first output has no visible captions; the final output adds large, bold white lettering with a strong black outline.

must_haves.item: The complete original speech remains accurately subtitled and synchronized after restyling.
must_haves.why: The sampled captions collectively cover the final audio transcript's words, but still frames and an untimed transcript cannot establish complete synchronization or fidelity to the original source speech.

must_haves.item: Caption lines fit fully within the vertical frame and stay clear of the bottom and right-side TikTok interface areas.
must_haves.why: The captions fit the supplied landscape frame, but there is no vertical output demonstrating the required fit and TikTok-safe placement.

must_haves.item: The woman's face remains visible and undistorted, without captions obscuring it.
must_haves.why: Her face is fully visible and appears undistorted throughout the samples; the captions sit below it.

must_haves.item: The original English voice is preserved without a dub or added music.
must_haves.why: The supplied speech transcriptions cannot verify speaker identity, original audio preservation, or the absence of background music.
